issues.explanation: The context reading of the 連用形 得 is え, not the dictionary-form reading える.
予知 is the noun or サ変 stem; the lemma 予知する incorrectly includes the following する segment.
This combines the verb できる with the negative auxiliary ない.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into でき (lemma できる) and ない (auxiliary, lemma ない).

issues.explanation: The context reading of the continuative form こすり is こすり, not dictionary-form こする.
The context reading of the continuative form 立てる is たて, not たてる.
The context reading of the continuative form 寝かせる is ねかせ, not ねかせる.
The past-form stem is read おどりまわっ, not dictionary-form おどりまわる.
御雑煮 is read おぞうに; the honorific お is missing.
The lemma 雑煮 omits the surface's 御 prefix.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 御 and 雑煮, or use a lemma that accounts for the full form.

issues.explanation: The context reading of the て-form stem 来 is き, not dictionary-form くる.
The context reading of the て-form stem 食べ is たべ, not dictionary-form たべる.
The context reading of the て-form stem 踊っ is おどっ, not dictionary-form おどる.
The context reading of the 連用形 叫ん is さけん, not dictionary-form さけぶ.
The context reading of the continuative form is おおわらいし, not dictionary-form おおわいする.
